# A Canadian company that bought US-listed shares and still holds them
#
# 12 NASDAQ:AMZN bought at 200.00 USD with the US dollar at 1.30, so
# 3,120.00 CAD left the bank — 260.00 CAD a share. Still held at the year
# end, with the share at 280.00 USD and the dollar at 1.42.
# 
# The shares open a cost basis of their own, in the book's own currency,
# at the 260.00 a share they cost. This book holds no foreign currency at
# all, so the page states the whole gain under unrealized_gains_other
# with unrealized_gains_fx at 0.00.
#
# Generated by scripts/generate-multi-currency-examples.sh. Not a
# test fixture — no test draws its figures from here — but the
# statement below is checked against what the tool prints, by
# tests/integration/test_each_worked_example_still_prints_the_statement_it_carries.py.
# Check it yourself:
#
#     gnucash-plaintext import --new /tmp/check.gnucash \
#         examples/multi-currency/us_listed_shares_bought_and_still_held.txt
#     gnucash-plaintext balance-sheet /tmp/check.gnucash --as-of 2026-12-31
#
# The statement that ledger produces is at the end of this file.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# What `balance-sheet --as-of 2026-12-31` prints for the book above.
#
# Commented, every line of it. A statement opens with a dated
# directive — `2026-12-31 balance-sheet` — and the import reads a
# line at column 0 as one, so a file carrying both would refuse to
# import and this example would not do the one thing it is for.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

# 2026-12-31 balance-sheet
# 	# An account line is that account's own balance — never its children's.
# 	# A section total, and any figure no account holds, is a key.
# 	# share_price: and value: under an account line are what this report
# 	# valued the holding at on this date, not the rate a split happened at.
# 	#
# 	# A gain already taken is stated apart from one the book has yet to
# 	# take, and only the unrealized total reaches total_equity.
# 	# gnucash_balancing_amount is GnuCash's own figure, carried across so
# 	# the two can be read against each other, and added into nothing.
# 	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
# 	Assets:AMZN 12.0000 AMZN
# 		account.commodity.mnemonic: "AMZN"
# 		share_price: "397.6"
# 		value: "4771.20"
# 	Assets:Bank 6880.00 CAD
# 	total_assets: 11651.20 CAD
# 	total_liabilities: 0.00 CAD
# 	Equity:Opening balances 10000.00 CAD
# 	unrealized_gains_assets_fx:
# 		commodities: # there is no cost basis on the asset side
# 		cost_value: 0.00 # sum of each commodity's cost_value
# 		value: 0.00 # sum of each commodity's value
# 		unrealized_gains_assets_fx: 0.00 # value - cost_value
# 	unrealized_gains_liabilities_fx: 0.00 CAD
# 	unrealized_gains_fx: 0.00 CAD # unrealized_gains_assets_fx + unrealized_gains_liabilities_fx
# 	realized_gains_fx:
# 		realized_gains_fx: 0.00
# 		splits: # there is no split
# 	realized_gains_other: 0.00 CAD
# 	total_realized_gains: 0.00 CAD # realized_gains_fx + realized_gains_other
# 	unrealized_gains_other: # sum of unrealized_gains_other of all securities and funds
# 		securities: # security, fund, etc
# 			security:
# 				commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
# 				commodity.mnemonic: "AMZN"
# 				quantity: 12.0000
# 				share_price: 397.6 # what price-fn returns for this commodity
# 				cost_bases:
# 					cost_basis:
# 						split_guid: b5aae44c0e124c4fb97f047d4581a6eb
# 						account: "Assets:AMZN"
# 						cost_basis_balance: 12.0000
# 						cost_share_price: 260 # AMZN in CAD, on the day it was bought
# 						cost_rate: 1 # CAD per CAD, on that same day
# 						cost_share_price_in_base: 260 # cost_share_price * cost_rate
# 						cost_value: 3120.00 # cost_basis_balance * cost_share_price_in_base
# 						value: 4771.20 # cost_basis_balance * share_price
# 						unrealized_gains_other: 1651.20 # value - cost_value
# 				accounts:
# 					account:
# 						guid: 35e6e1347200416ba33c88300f7fc5b4
# 						name: "Assets:AMZN"
# 						balance: 12.0000
# 						splits:
# 							split_amount 12.0000 | value 3120.00 CAD
# 				value: 4771.20 # the holding converted at the sheet's price
# 				cost_value: 3120.00 # what its cost bases say the units cost
# 				unrealized_gains_other: 1651.20 # value - cost_value
# 		value: 4771.20 # sum of each security's value
# 		cost_value: 3120.00 # sum of each security's cost_value
# 		unrealized_gains_other: 1651.20 # value - cost_value
# 	total_unrealized_gains: 1651.20 CAD # unrealized_gains_fx + unrealized_gains_other
# 	gnucash_balancing_amount: # the commodities GnuCash's own figure is summed from
# 		commodities:
# 			commodity:
# 				commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
# 				splits:
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: b5aae44c0e124c4fb97f047d4581a6eb
# 						account: "Assets:AMZN"
# 						value: 3120.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: 0b03034a020c4558869d5fc16fa79dc0
# 						account: "Assets:Bank"
# 						value: 10000.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: ade8fac586ec4764930bdca9a1e0352a
# 						account: "Assets:Bank"
# 						value: -3120.00
# 				sum_value: 10000.00 # sum of split's value of all splits
# 				accounts:
# 					account:
# 						guid: bb3ce3b01d114068be8fc0245a8a1eaa
# 						name: "Assets"
# 						balance: 0.00
# 					account:
# 						guid: d03c99beea1b4d96880013323fcde6ad
# 						name: "Assets:Bank"
# 						balance: 6880.00
# 				balance_value: 6880.00 # sum of account's balance for all accounts
# 				gains_before_conversion: -3120.00 # what GnuCash's own figure holds for this commodity
# 				balance_sheet_value: -3120.00 # -3120.00 CAD at 1 CAD per CAD
# 			commodity:
# 				commodity.mnemonic: "AMZN"
# 				splits: # there is no split
# 				sum_value: 0.0000 # sum of split's value of all splits
# 				accounts:
# 					account:
# 						guid: 35e6e1347200416ba33c88300f7fc5b4
# 						name: "Assets:AMZN"
# 						balance: 12.0000
# 				balance_value: 12.0000 # sum of account's balance for all accounts
# 				gains_before_conversion: 12.0000 # what GnuCash's own figure holds for this commodity
# 				balance_sheet_value: 4771.20 # 12.0000 AMZN at 397.6 CAD per AMZN
# 		gnucash_balancing_amount: 1651.20 # sum of balance_sheet_value of all commodities
# 	total_equity: 11651.20 CAD
# 	total_liabilities_and_equity: 11651.20 CAD
